details:
Fatal error in GC - SuspendThread loop failed only during EAC-protected launch

VRChat intermittently/frequently fails during startup with a Windows dialog:

Fatal error in GC

SuspendThread loop failed

The failure occurs very early during startup, before VRChat finishes loading.

Steps to reproduce:

Start VRChat normally through Steam.

Easy Anti-Cheat launches normally.

During VRChat startup, a "Fatal error in GC - SuspendThread loop failed" dialog appears.

VRChat terminates after acknowledging the error.

Important diagnostic finding:

Launching VRChat.exe directly without the normal EAC-protected launch consistently starts VRChat successfully in offline testing mode. The SuspendThread failure occurs when launching normally through Steam/Easy Anti-Cheat.

Windows Event Viewer crash information:

Faulting application: VRChat.exe

Faulting module: GameAssembly.dll

Exception code: 0x80000003

Fault offset: 0x0000000000a89d7a

Troubleshooting already performed:

Verified VRChat files through Steam.

Repaired Easy Anti-Cheat.

Performed EasyAntiCheat_EOS.exe qa-factory-reset.

EAC was successfully reset; Windows requested EAC permissions again afterward.

Problem remained after EAC reset and reboot.

Updated AMD chipset drivers.

Tested with Windows Memory Integrity/HVCI disabled.

Tested Windows Defender Real-time Protection both enabled and after toggling it.

Tested clean boot / disabling non-Microsoft startup services.

Tested with Virtual Desktop, Wacom, Everything and other background services stopped.

No custom VRChat CPU affinity or Process Lasso configuration is being used.

Direct non-EAC VRChat launch continues to work.
title: Fatal error in GC - SuspendThread loop failed
